MOTEMS — Marine Oil Terminal Engineering and Maintenance Standards, California Building Code Title 24 Part 2 Chapter 31F, administered by the California State Lands Commission Marine Environmental Protection Division. Requires periodic audits above and below the waterline covering structural, seismic, geotechnical, mooring, berthing, fire protection, piping, mechanical, electrical and corrosion evaluation to prove continued fitness-for-purpose, with Executive Summary Tables submitted to the Commission annually by 31 January. This is the strongest San Francisco Bay proof hook available and no competitor page in the top five references it

Bay Area Air Quality Management District (BAAQMD) — the regional air regulator for the nine Bay Area counties and the body that fines the refineries; name it as the compliance context for tank, flare and fugitive-emission asset work
Contra Costa County Industrial Safety Ordinance (ISO) — county-level process safety requirement applying to the Richmond and Martinez refineries, on top of federal PSM

Cal/OSHA Process Safety Management for Petroleum Refineries, Title 8 CCR §5189.1 (with general PSM at §5189) — California's refinery-specific PSM standard, including damage mechanism review and hierarchy-of-hazard-control requirements that as-built accuracy feeds
California Accidental Release Prevention (CalARP) programme and the county CUPA administering it
California Office of the State Fire Marshal, Pipeline Safety Division — intrastate hazardous liquid pipeline regulator for the Bay Area corridor
San Francisco Bay Regional Water Quality Control Board (Region 2) and DTSC — site and secondary-containment context for tank farm work
Port of Oakland, Port of San Francisco, and Port of Richmond — cranes, wharves, transit sheds and marine structures as non-refinery reality-capture assets
